checks: Parsed the entire 1.4 MB JavaScript bundle into 489284 TypeScript AST nodes with zero parse diagnostics; scanned complete literal/call structure for module requests, postMessage, persistence and credential/API headers. No application API or credential-bearing header literals were present.

Reviewed business boundaries and their consumers: scoped scene/local-model/camera-capture persistence; import/hydration/rebinding; undo/copy/paste/delete; camera targeting; panorama normalization; parent bridge initialization/project notifications; capture/MP4 recording cleanup; viewport state and inspector rendering. Business regions are interleaved with third-party dependencies.

Fixed camera inspector hook-order crash when deleting the last camera in camera view by mounting its hook-bearing component only when an active camera exists. Before-fix Chrome returned React error 300 and an empty body; after-fix delete and undo both pass.

Fixed paste helper retargeting every existing camera to copied actors. It now remaps only newly pasted cameras. A regression executes the actual shipped paste function in both camera-first and actor-first clipboard orders; failed before, passes after.

Verified a reverse application of the two exact business-code substitutions equals the original tracked bundle byte-for-byte. All vendor code remains unchanged; frontend build copied the exact fixed bundle into embedded assets.
